title: a commit seals a proof it adds
intention: The pre-commit reseal runs a staged proof file that has no seal yet, as one of the proofs of the component that owns it, so a commit that adds a proof lands with that proof's seal.
why: Measured 2026-11-24 on akiendelllinux (cairn dde12e2d0): proofs_touching (cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py:339) chooses from census() (:299), and census builds its rows only from validations/*.json, so a proof with no validation is never a row and no commit runs it. On 11-24 the red-first teeth of 0d98f7325181 and f5859eae9e08 were committed as new files (a92ca9d99, f64e95bfe) and landed with no seal; both were sealed by hand (79ca822c5). The orchestrator counts n=4 across the 11-21..11-24 voyages. Recorded at ~/.cairn/devices/cc/0/measurements/land-hook-gaps-2026-11-24.md.
how: In proofs_touching, a staged path matching <component>/proofs/test_*.py that census holds no row for is added to the result, so reseal_all runs it and --stage stages its first seal. A red-first proof seals red, which is the seal it should carry.

clauses.claim: over a scratch repo, proofs_touching of a staged new proofs/test_x.py with no validation returns that proof
a staged non-proof file with no validation adds no proof, and a staged sealed proof is returned exactly once

decisions.text: D1: cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py proofs_touching adds a staged proof file the census does not hold.
D2: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_commit_seals_a_proof_it_adds.py, one PROVES key per clause, over a scratch repo.

out: the hook script (the ruling is its own ticket)
census() itself (its other readers want sealed rows only)

traces_to: Law 8 (a proof enters proven-space with its seal, taken by the tester, not by a hand that remembered) and Law 4 (the reseal door is physics; a gap a hand fills each time is policy).
